claim: Every storage-locations route answers only for the caller's house (ADR 0147). The path's :restaurantId is refused unless it is the token's house by JwtAuthGuard's assertTenantMatch (pinned by storage-locations-house-scope.spec.ts, which drives the real guard over every route Nest declares on the controller), and a location id after it is checked against that house: assigning a wine to, or reading the wines at, another house's zone is a 404 with nothing written (assertLocationIsTheHouses); updateLocation reads with maybeSingle so no row is a 404, not a 500; deleteLocation filters deleted_at and answers 404 when it matched no row instead of { success: true }
verify: f=apps/api-gateway/src/storage-locations/storage-locations.service.ts; s=apps/api-gateway/src/storage-locations/storage-locations-house-scope.spec.ts; grep -q 'await this.assertLocationIsTheHouses(restaurantId, dto.locationId);' $f && grep -q 'await this.assertLocationIsTheHouses(restaurantId, locationId);' $f && [ "$(grep -c 'No storage location of this house has that id.' $f)" -ge 2 ] && ! sed -n '/async updateLocation(/,/^  }/p' $f | grep -q '[.]single();' && sed -n '/async deleteLocation(/,/^  }/p' $f | grep -q 'deleted_at", null' && grep -q 'refuses house B.s id in the path with 403' $s && grep -q 'new JwtAuthGuard(new Reflector()' $s && grep -q 'assertTenantMatch(request, {' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts
